svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Journal containers
svg.desc: The journal as a set of containers: the callers that write, the writer and its schema, the state directory it writes into, and the consumers that read it back.

g.text: CALLERS · ENGINE COMMANDS THAT WRITE EVENTS
